ex.s: 我鍾意食生果，例如蘋果同橙。
ex.r: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 saang1 gwo2 lai6 jyu4 ping4 gwo2 tung4 caang2
ex.en: I like fruit, for example apples and oranges.

ex.s: 我週末會做運動，例如游水。
ex.r: ngo5 zau1 mut6 wui5 zou6 wan6 dung6 lai6 jyu4 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: On weekends I exercise, for example swimming.

ex.s: 去旅行要帶啲嘢，例如護照。
ex.r: heoi3 leoi5 hang4 jiu3 daai3 di1 je5 lai6 jyu4 wu6 ziu3
ex.en: When you travel, bring a few things, like your passport.

note: Opposite: 開 (hoi1), to open or turn on.

ex.r: ceot1 mun4 hau2 gei3 dak1 gwaan1 dang1
ex.en: Remember to turn off the lights when you go out.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 tau2 gei2 dim2 gwaan1 mun4 aa3
ex.en: What time does the shop close?

ex.s: 好凍呀，可唔可以關咗個冷氣？
ex.r: hou2 dung3 aa3 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gwaan1 zo2 go3 laang5 hei3
ex.en: It's so cold, can we turn off the air conditioning?

en: to have a day off; be on holiday

ex.r: ting1 jat6 fong3 gaa3 nei5 jau5 me1 daa2 syun3
ex.en: We're off tomorrow. What are your plans?

ex.r: fong3 gaa3 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: On our holiday we're going to Japan.

ex.r: hok6 haau6 gei2 si4 fong3 gaa3 aa3
ex.en: When does school break start?

note: 唔舒服 = unwell, feeling sick.

ex.r: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa2 hou2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: This sofa is really comfortable.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 hai6 gei2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: I'm not feeling very well today.

ex.r: deoi3 haai4 zoek3 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: These shoes are really comfortable to wear.

note: Measure word 份 (fan6): 一份報紙.

ex.r: baa4 baa1 mui5 ziu1 dou1 tai2 bou3 zi2
ex.en: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.

ex.r: bin6 lei6 dim3 jau5 bou3 zi2 maai6
ex.en: The convenience store sells newspapers.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 dei6 tit3 dou6 tai2 gan2 bou3 zi2
ex.en: He's reading a newspaper on the subway.

ex.r: keoi5 ci4 dou3 ge3 jyun4 jan1 hai6 sak1 ce1
ex.en: The reason he was late was traffic.

ex.s: 醫生話咳嘅原因係敏感。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 kat1 ge3 jyun4 jan1 hai6 man5 gam2
ex.en: The doctor said the cough is caused by an allergy.

ex.s: 我鍾意呢間餐廳，原因好簡單：平。
ex.r: ngo5 zung1 ji3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jyun4 jan1 hou2 gaan2 daan1 peng4
ex.en: I like this restaurant for a simple reason: it's cheap.

en: to mail; to send by post
note: For email and texts, people say 發 or 'send'.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 gei3 fung1 seon3 heoi3 mei5 gwok3
ex.en: I want to mail a letter to the US.

ex.s: 網上買嘅嘢幾時寄到呀？
ex.r: mong5 soeng6 maai5 ge3 je5 gei2 si4 gei3 dou3 aa3
ex.en: When will the stuff I bought online arrive?

ex.r: saang1 jat6 kaat1 ngo5 gei3 zo2 bei2 maa4 maa4
ex.en: I mailed the birthday card to Grandma.

note: For replying to messages, people usually say 覆 (fuk1).

ex.r: lou5 si1 man6 man6 tai4 keoi5 daap3 m4 dou2
ex.en: The teacher asked a question and he couldn't answer.

ex.r: min6 si3 go2 zan6 keoi5 daap3 dak1 hou2 hou2
ex.en: She answered really well in the interview.

ex.s: 佢問我去唔去，我答佢話去。
ex.r: keoi5 man6 ngo5 heoi3 m4 heoi3 ngo5 daap3 keoi5 waa6 heoi3
ex.en: He asked if I was going, and I told him yes.

note: 瞓覺 (fan3 gaau3) = to sleep. Avoid Mandarin 睡.

ex.r: hou2 je6 laa3 faai3 di1 fan3 laa1
ex.en: It's late, go to sleep.

ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 fan3 dak1 m4 hou2
ex.en: I didn't sleep well last night.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 fan3 zoek6 zo2
ex.en: He fell asleep on the bus.

ex.r: zou6 jyun4 gung1 fo3 sin1 ho2 ji5 waan2
ex.en: You can play only after you finish your homework.

ex.r: gam1 jat6 lou5 si1 bei2 hou2 do1 gung1 fo3
ex.en: The teacher gave a lot of homework today.

ex.s: 我同同學一齊喺圖書館做功課。
ex.r: ngo5 tung4 tung4 hok6 jat1 cai4 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 zou6 gung1 fo3
ex.en: I do homework with my classmates at the library.

ex.s: 呢個菜好簡單，十分鐘就整好。
ex.r: ni1 go3 coi3 hou2 gaan2 daan1 sap6 fan1 zung1 zau6 zing2 hou2
ex.en: This dish is simple; it's ready in ten minutes.

ex.s: 張表好簡單，填個名就得。
ex.r: zoeng1 biu2 hou2 gaan2 daan1 tin4 go3 meng2 zau6 dak1
ex.en: The form is simple; just fill in your name.

ex.s: 我哋簡單食個飯就算喇。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gaan2 daan1 sik6 go3 faan6 zau6 syun3 laa3
ex.en: Let's just have a simple meal.

ex.s: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好一般。
ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 jat1 bun1
ex.en: The food at this restaurant is so-so.

ex.r: tou3 hei3 jat1 bun1 laa1 m4 syun3 hou2 tai2
ex.en: The movie was average, not that good.

ex.r: ngo5 jat1 bun1 cat1 dim2 hei2 san1
ex.en: I usually get up at seven.

note: Also used to call a shop owner or stall keeper.

ex.r: ngo5 lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 dou6
ex.en: My boss isn't in today.

ex.r: gaan1 pou3 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hou2 jan4
ex.en: The shop owner is really nice.

ex.r: lou5 baan2 maai4 daan1 m4 goi1
ex.en: Boss, the bill please!

ex.r: lok6 daai6 jyu5 jing2 hoeng2 zo2 gaau1 tung1
ex.en: The heavy rain affected traffic.

ex.s: 夜晚飲咖啡會影響瞓覺。
ex.r: je6 maan5 jam2 gaa3 fe1 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 fan3 gaau3
ex.en: Drinking coffee at night affects your sleep.

ex.s: 唔好嘈，會影響人哋溫書。
ex.r: m4 hou2 cou4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 jan4 dei6 wan1 syu1
ex.en: Don't be noisy, you'll disturb people studying.

note: Also 有時 (jau5 si4).

ex.r: ngo5 jau5 zan6 si4 wui5 zi6 gei2 zyu2 faan6
ex.en: Sometimes I cook for myself.

ex.s: 有陣時我會搭的士返工。
ex.r: jau5 zan6 si4 ngo5 wui5 daap3 dik1 si2 faan1 gung1
ex.en: Sometimes I take a taxi to work.

ex.s: 呢度冬天有陣時都幾凍。
ex.r: ni1 dou6 dung1 tin1 jau5 zan6 si4 dou1 gei2 dung3
ex.en: It's sometimes pretty cold here in winter.

note: Opposite: 入邊 (jap6 bin6), inside.

ex.r: ceot1 bin6 lok6 gan2 jyu5 daai3 baa2 ze1 laa1
ex.en: It's raining outside, take an umbrella.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ceot1 bin6 dang2 nei5
ex.en: I'll wait for you outside.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 ceot1 bin6 sik6 laa1
ex.en: Let's eat out tonight.

note: 粒鐘 (lap1 zung1) = one hour, very colloquial.

ex.r: sik6 loeng5 lap1 joek6 jat1 jat6 saam1 ci3
ex.en: Take two pills, three times a day.

ex.r: ni1 lap1 tong2 hou2 tim4
ex.en: This candy is really sweet.

ex.r: ngo5 dang2 zo2 nei5 seng4 lap1 zung1
ex.en: I waited for you a whole hour!

en: to hand in; to pay; to make (friends)

ex.r: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3
ex.en: The homework is due tomorrow.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 jat1 hou6 gaau1 zou1
ex.en: I pay rent on the first of every month.

ex.s: 佢喺英國讀書，交咗好多朋友。
ex.r: keoi5 hai2 jing1 gwok3 duk6 syu1 gaau1 zo2 hou2 do1 pang4 jau5
ex.en: He studied in the UK and made lots of friends.

note: Read cung5 for 'heavy'. Meaning 'still', it's zung6 (like 仲).

ex.r: go3 doi2 hou2 cung5 aa3 bong1 ngo5 ling1 haa5
ex.en: This bag is heavy, help me carry it.

ex.r: nei5 go3 hang4 lei5 soeng1 cung5 m4 cung5 aa3
ex.en: Is your suitcase heavy?

ex.r: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 cung5 zo2 loeng5 bong6
ex.en: She's put on two pounds recently.

ex.s: 收音機播緊我最鍾意嘅歌。
ex.r: sau1 jam1 gei1 bo3 gan2 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 go1
ex.en: The radio is playing my favorite song.

ex.r: tou3 kek6 gei2 dim2 bo3 aa3
ex.en: What time does the drama air?

ex.s: 你喺手機播段片俾我睇吓。
ex.r: nei5 hai2 sau2 gei1 bo3 dyun6 pin2 bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5
ex.en: Play the video on your phone for me.

note: Opposite: 落嚟 (come down). 上去 = go up.

ex.r: nei5 soeng5 lai4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 co5 haa5 laa1
ex.en: Come up to my place for a bit.

ex.r: ngoi6 maai6 sung3 zo2 soeng5 lai4 laa3
ex.en: The takeout has been brought up.

ex.s: 我喺二樓，你行樓梯上嚟啦。
ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ji6 lau2 nei5 haang4 lau4 tai1 soeng5 lai4 laa1
ex.en: I'm on the second floor; take the stairs up.

ex.r: di1 man1 hou2 faan4 aa3
ex.en: These mosquitoes are so annoying!

ex.r: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daa2 din6 waa2 lai4 hou2 faan4
ex.en: He calls all the time; it's so annoying.

ex.r: ngo5 wai6 zo2 wan2 gung1 hou2 faan4
ex.en: I'm stressed about finding a job.

en: to drive; to hold (in the hand)
note: 揸車 = to drive a car. Avoid Mandarin 開車.

ex.r: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 zaa1 ce1 aa3
ex.en: Can you drive?

ex.r: ngo5 zaa1 ce1 sung3 nei5 faan1 uk1 kei2
ex.en: I'll drive you home.

ex.r: keoi5 sau2 zaa1 zyu6 bui1 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: She's holding a cup of coffee.

ex.r: ngo5 do1 sou3 co5 dei6 tit3 faan1 gung1
ex.en: I usually take the subway to work.

ex.r: zau1 mut6 ngo5 do1 sou3 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2
ex.en: On weekends I mostly stay home.

ex.s: 班上多數同學都識游水。
ex.r: baan1 soeng6 do1 sou3 tung4 hok6 dou1 sik1 jau4 seoi2
ex.en: Most of the students in the class can swim.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 aa3 dei6 haa2 hou2 waat6
ex.en: Careful, the floor is slippery.

ex.r: gwo3 maa5 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1
ex.en: Be careful crossing the road.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 di1 go3 dip2 hou2 jit6
ex.en: Careful, the plate is hot.

note: Often paired with 就: 只要…就….

ex.r: zi2 jiu3 nei5 zung1 ji3 zau6 dak1 laa3
ex.en: As long as you like it, that's fine.

ex.s: 只要唔落雨，我哋就去行山。
ex.r: zi2 jiu3 m4 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 zau6 heoi3 haang4 saan1
ex.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go hiking.

ex.s: 只要多啲練習，你一定得。
ex.r: zi2 jiu3 do1 di1 lin6 zaap6 nei5 jat1 ding6 dak1
ex.en: As long as you practice more, you'll get it.

note: Measure word 首 (sau2): 一首歌.

ex.r: nei5 zung1 ji3 teng1 bin1 go3 ge3 go1 aa3
ex.en: Whose songs do you like to listen to?

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 coeng3 go1
ex.en: She loves singing.

ex.r: zaa1 ce1 go2 zan6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 teng1 go1
ex.en: I like listening to music while I drive.

note: 錄音 = record audio; 錄影 = record video.

ex.r: ngo5 jung6 sau2 gei1 luk6 zo2 dyun6 pin2
ex.en: I recorded a video on my phone.

ex.s: 個節目我錄咗，第日先睇。
ex.r: go3 zit3 muk6 ngo5 luk6 zo2 dai6 jat6 sin1 tai2
ex.en: I recorded the show to watch another day.

ex.r: soeng5 tong4 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 luk6 jam1 aa3
ex.en: Can I record audio in class?

note: Colloquial; the written word is 浪費.

ex.r: m4 hou2 saai1 je5 sik6 aa3
ex.en: Don't waste food.

ex.s: 排咗成個鐘隊，真係嘥時間。
ex.r: paai4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 deoi2 zan1 hai6 saai1 si4 gaan3
ex.en: We queued a whole hour; what a waste of time.

ex.s: 冇人就熄燈啦，唔好嘥電。
ex.r: mou5 jan4 zau6 sik1 dang1 laa1 m4 hou2 saai1 din6
ex.en: Turn off the lights if no one's there; don't waste electricity.

ex.r: di1 juk6 suk6 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Is the meat cooked yet?

ex.r: di1 hoeng1 ziu1 mei6 suk6 dang2 do1 loeng5 jat6
ex.en: The bananas aren't ripe; wait two more days.

ex.r: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 hou2 suk6
ex.en: I know him really well.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 nei5 jat1 ding6 dak1
ex.en: I believe you can do it.

ex.r: nei5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 me1
ex.en: You believe what he says?

ex.s: 醫生話冇事，你要相信醫生。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 mou5 si6 nei5 jiu3 soeng1 seon3 ji1 sang1
ex.en: The doctor says you're fine; trust the doctor.

note: Measure words: 枝 (zi1) for one stem, 束 (cuk1) for a bunch.

ex.r: ngo5 maai5 zo2 cuk1 faa1 bei2 maa4 maa1
ex.en: I bought a bunch of flowers for Mom.

ex.r: gung1 jyun2 di1 faa1 hoi1 saai3 laa3
ex.en: The flowers in the park are all in bloom.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 lou6 toi4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 faa1
ex.en: She grows lots of flowers on her balcony.

ex.r: ngo5 ning4 jyun2 haang4 lou6 m4 soeng2 daap3 ce1
ex.en: I'd rather walk than take a ride.

ex.r: ngo5 ning4 jyun2 hai2 uk1 kei2 sik6
ex.en: I'd rather eat at home.

ex.s: 佢寧願少啲人工都要早啲放工。
ex.r: keoi5 ning4 jyun2 siu2 di1 jan4 gung1 dou1 jiu3 zou2 di1 fong3 gung1
ex.en: She'd rather earn less and finish work earlier.

note: Here 重 is zung6, not cung5 (heavy).

ex.r: ting1 jat6 go3 wui2 hou2 zung6 jiu3
ex.en: Tomorrow's meeting is very important.

ex.r: san1 tai2 gin6 hong1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3
ex.en: Good health is the most important thing.

ex.r: gei3 dak1 daai3 wu6 ziu3 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3
ex.en: Remember your passport, it's really important.

note: Colloquial 'next to'. In the news it can also mean 'quarantine'.

ex.r: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 keoi5 gaak3 lei4
ex.en: I live next door to him.

ex.r: ngan4 hong4 zau6 hai2 ciu1 si5 gaak3 lei4
ex.en: The bank is right next to the supermarket.

ex.r: ngo5 co5 hai2 san1 tung4 hok6 gaak3 lei4
ex.en: I sit next to the new classmate.

ex.r: nei5 gaan1 fong2 hou2 lyun6 aa3
ex.en: Your room is so messy!

ex.r: di1 man4 gin2 fong3 dak1 hou2 lyun6
ex.en: The documents are all over the place.

ex.r: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gong2 je5 aa3
ex.en: Don't talk nonsense!

note: Opposite: 難 (naan4). Also 容易.

ex.r: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 hou2 ji6
ex.en: This exam was easy.

ex.r: ni1 go3 si4 gaan3 hou2 ji6 zit6 dik1 si2
ex.en: It's easy to get a taxi at this time.

ex.r: tin1 dung3 hou2 ji6 gam2 mou6
ex.en: It's easy to catch a cold when it's cold.

ex.r: dong1 si4 ngo5 zung6 hai6 hok6 saang1
ex.en: Back then I was still a student.

ex.s: 當時好多人，我睇唔到你。
ex.r: dong1 si4 hou2 do1 jan4 ngo5 tai2 m4 dou2 nei5
ex.en: There were so many people then that I couldn't see you.

ex.r: ngo5 dong1 si4 m4 zi1 keoi5 beng6 zo2
ex.en: I didn't know at the time that she was sick.

en: to pick up (someone); to answer (a call)

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 zip3 nei5
ex.en: I'll pick you up at the airport.

ex.r: fong3 hok6 ngo5 heoi3 zip3 go3 zai2
ex.en: I'll pick up my son after school.

ex.r: keoi5 hoi1 gan2 wui2 zip3 m4 dou2 din6 waa2
ex.en: She's in a meeting and can't take calls.

note: Usually followed by 都. Same as 每日.

ex.r: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jam2 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I drink coffee every day.

ex.r: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 zou6 wan6 dung6
ex.en: He works out every day.

ex.r: jat6 jat6 dou1 gam3 jit6 hou2 san1 fu2
ex.en: It's this hot every day; it's rough.

ex.r: ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 jau1 sik1 haa5
ex.en: I just want to rest a bit.

ex.r: zi2 hai6 tai2 haa5 m4 goi1
ex.en: Just looking, thanks.

ex.r: keoi5 m4 hai6 nau1 nei5 zi2 hai6 hou2 gui6
ex.en: She's not mad at you, she's just tired.

note: 冇關係 = it doesn't matter, no problem.

ex.r: mou5 gwaan1 hai6 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1
ex.en: It's okay, don't worry.

ex.r: keoi5 tung4 lou5 baan2 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2
ex.en: He gets along really well with the boss.

ex.r: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 me1 gwaan1 hai6 aa3
ex.en: How are those two related?

note: 係噉先 = that's all for now. 係噉 + verb = keep doing.

ex.r: jyun4 loi4 hai6 gam2
ex.en: Oh, so that's how it is!

ex.r: hai6 gam2 sin1 laa1 ting1 jat6 gin3
ex.en: That's it for now, see you tomorrow.

ex.r: keoi5 hai6 gam2 haam3 m4 hang2 ting4
ex.en: He keeps crying and won't stop.

ex.r: ngo5 zeon2 bei6 gan2 maan5 faan6
ex.en: I'm making dinner.

ex.s: 你準備好未呀？我哋要走喇。
ex.r: nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 mei6 aa3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zau2 laa3
ex.en: Are you ready? We have to go.

ex.r: ting1 jat6 min6 si3 ngo5 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 haa5
ex.en: I have an interview tomorrow; I need to prepare.

note: Measure word 隻. As 'a plate of' (一碟飯), it's read dip6.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 do1 zek3 dip2 ngo5
ex.en: Could I have another plate, please?

ex.r: bong1 sau2 lo2 di1 dip2 ceot1 lai4
ex.en: Help bring the plates out.

ex.r: ni1 tou3 dip2 hou2 leng3 gei2 cin2 aa3
ex.en: This set of plates is nice. How much is it?

en: to discover; to find out; to realize

ex.s: 我返到屋企先發現冇帶鎖匙。
ex.r: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 sin1 faat3 jin6 mou5 daai3 so2 si4
ex.en: I only realized I'd forgotten my keys when I got home.

ex.s: 我發現呢間餐廳好好食。
ex.r: ngo5 faat3 jin6 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 hou2 sik6
ex.en: I found out this restaurant is really good.

ex.r: ji1 sang1 faat3 jin6 keoi5 hyut3 aat3 gou1
ex.en: The doctor found she has high blood pressure.

ex.r: haau2 si5 git3 gwo2 gei2 si4 ceot1 aa3
ex.en: When do the exam results come out?

ex.r: jim6 hyut3 git3 gwo2 mou5 man6 tai4
ex.en: The blood test results are fine.

ex.s: 我哋等咗好耐，結果佢冇嚟。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6 git3 gwo2 keoi5 mou5 lai4
ex.en: We waited ages, and in the end he didn't come.

ex.r: syu2 gaa3 nei5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 waan2 aa3
ex.en: Where are you going for summer vacation?

ex.s: 暑假我喺咖啡店做兼職。
ex.r: syu2 gaa3 ngo5 hai2 gaa3 fe1 dim3 zou6 gim1 zik1
ex.en: Over the summer I work part-time at a café.

ex.s: 啲細路暑假日日喺屋企打機。
ex.r: di1 sai3 lou6 syu2 gaa3 jat6 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 daa2 gei1
ex.en: The kids play video games at home every day over the summer.

note: Verb + 齊 = do all of it. 人齊 = everyone's here.

ex.r: jan4 cai4 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Is everyone here yet?

ex.r: di1 je5 maai5 cai4 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you bought everything?

ex.r: man4 gin2 daai3 cai4 saai3 laa3
ex.en: I've brought all the documents.

note: Family name comes first: 陳先生 = Mr. Chan.

ex.r: can4 sin1 saang1 nei5 hou2
ex.en: Hello, Mr. Chan.

ex.r: sin1 saang1 nei5 jiu3 di1 me1 aa3
ex.en: Sir, what would you like?

ex.r: ngo5 sin1 saang1 gam1 maan5 gaa1 baan1
ex.en: My husband is working late tonight.

ex.r: nei5 kyut3 ding6 zo2 sik6 me1 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you decided what to eat?

ex.s: 我決定聽年去台灣讀書。
ex.r: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ting1 nin2 heoi3 toi4 waan1 duk6 syu1
ex.en: I've decided to study in Taiwan next year.

ex.r: maai5 bin1 gaa3 ce1 nei5 kyut3 ding6 laa1
ex.en: You decide which car to buy.

ex.r: keoi5 uk1 kei2 hou2 jau5 cin2
ex.en: His family is very rich.

ex.r: dang2 ngo5 jau5 cin2 sin1 maai5 san1 sau2 gei1
ex.en: I'll buy a new phone when I have money.

ex.s: 出糧之後就有錢食好嘢。
ex.r: ceot1 loeng4 zi1 hau6 zau6 jau5 cin2 sik6 hou2 je5
ex.en: After payday we have money for good food.

note: 搬屋 = to move house.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 bun1 uk1
ex.en: We're moving next month.

ex.r: keoi5 gung1 si1 bun1 zo2 heoi3 gun1 tong4
ex.en: His company moved to Kwun Tong.

ex.r: ni1 soeng1 je5 hou2 cung5 ngo5 bun1 m4 juk1
ex.en: This box is too heavy; I can't move it.

ex.r: ngo5 mui5 jat6 faan1 baat3 go3 zung1 tau4 gung1
ex.en: I work eight hours a day.

ex.s: 由香港飛東京要四個鐘頭。
ex.r: jau4 hoeng1 gong2 fei1 dung1 ging1 jiu3 sei3 go3 zung1 tau4
ex.en: Flying from Hong Kong to Tokyo takes four hours.

ex.s: 我哋傾咗兩個鐘頭電話。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 king1 zo2 loeng5 go3 zung1 tau4 din6 waa2
ex.en: We talked on the phone for two hours.

note: 洗衫 = do laundry. To shower is 沖涼 (cung1 loeng4).

ex.r: sik6 faan6 cin4 jiu3 sai2 sau2
ex.en: Wash your hands before eating.

ex.r: gam1 maan5 dou3 nei5 sai2 wun2
ex.en: It's your turn to do the dishes tonight.

ex.r: ngo5 heoi3 faat3 jing4 uk1 sai2 tau4
ex.en: I'm going to the hair salon to get my hair washed.

note: 排隊 (paai4 deoi2) = to queue.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 pou3 jiu3 paai4 hou2 noi6 deoi2
ex.en: You have to queue a long time at this shop.

ex.r: daai6 gaa1 paai4 hou2 deoi2 soeng5 ce1
ex.en: Everyone, line up to get on.

ex.s: 我哋排咗成個鐘先入到場。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 paai4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 sin1 jap6 dou2 coeng4
ex.en: We queued a whole hour before we got into the venue.

note: 夜晚 = night. 瞓得夜 = go to bed late.

ex.r: hou2 je6 laa3 ngo5 dei6 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1
ex.en: It's late; let's go home.

ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 zou6 dou3 hou2 je6
ex.en: I have to work late today.

ex.s: 咁夜仲食嘢，對身體唔好。
ex.r: gam3 je6 zung6 sik6 je5 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2
ex.en: Eating this late isn't good for you.

note: 病咗 = (has) got sick.

ex.r: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1
ex.en: He's sick and not coming to work today.

ex.r: ngo5 go3 zai2 beng6 zo2 jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1
ex.en: My son is sick and needs to see a doctor.

ex.r: tin1 hei3 zyun2 dung3 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 beng6
ex.en: The weather turned cold, and lots of people are sick.

ex.r: tin1 hei3 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 jit6
ex.en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

ex.s: 你廣東話講得越嚟越好喎！
ex.r: nei5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 gong2 dak1 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 hou2 wo3
ex.en: Your Cantonese is getting better and better!

ex.r: di1 je5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 gwai3
ex.en: Things are getting more and more expensive.

note: Often 還返 (waan4 faan1), to give back.

ex.r: ngo5 ting1 jat6 waan4 cin2 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I'll pay you back tomorrow.

ex.r: di1 syu1 jiu3 waan4 faan1 bei2 tou4 syu1 gun2
ex.en: The books need to go back to the library.

ex.s: 架車你用完記得還返俾我。
ex.r: gaa3 ce1 nei5 jung6 jyun4 gei3 dak1 waan4 faan1 bei2 ngo5
ex.en: Remember to give the car back when you're done.

note: Only for past events. For future 'later', use 遲啲 or 第時.

ex.r: keoi5 hau6 loi4 bun1 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6
ex.en: Later he moved to Canada.

ex.s: 我哋本來想去，後來落雨就冇去。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 bun2 loi4 soeng2 heoi3 hau6 loi4 lok6 jyu5 zau6 mou5 heoi3
ex.en: We meant to go, but then it rained, so we didn't.

ex.r: hau6 loi4 dim2 aa3 nei5 wan2 dou2 gung1 mei6
ex.en: What happened after that? Did you find a job?

note: Friendly way to address a young woman, e.g. a shop assistant.

ex.r: nei5 go3 neoi2 hou2 leng3 neoi2 aa3
ex.en: Your daughter is so pretty!

ex.r: keoi5 neoi5 pang4 jau5 hou2 leng3 neoi2
ex.en: His girlfriend is very pretty.

ex.s: 靚女，呢件衫有冇細碼呀？
ex.r: leng3 neoi2 ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 mou5 sai3 maa5 aa3
ex.en: Miss, do you have this top in a small?

ex.r: keoi5 jau5 sap6 nin4 gaau3 syu1 ging1 jim6
ex.en: She has ten years of teaching experience.

ex.s: 去日本旅行係個好特別嘅經驗。
ex.r: heoi3 jat6 bun2 leoi5 hang4 hai6 go3 hou2 dak6 bit6 ge3 ging1 jim6
ex.en: Traveling in Japan was a really special experience.

ex.r: cau3 sai3 lou6 ngo5 mou5 mat1 ging1 jim6
ex.en: I don't have much experience looking after kids.

note: Opposite: 女仔 (girl).

ex.r: keoi5 saang1 zo2 go3 naam4 zai2
ex.en: She had a baby boy.

ex.r: baan1 soeng6 jau5 sap6 go3 naam4 zai2
ex.en: There are ten boys in the class.

ex.s: 嗰個男仔係你朋友嚟㗎？
ex.r: go2 go3 naam4 zai2 hai6 nei5 pang4 jau5 lai4 gaa3
ex.en: Is that guy your friend?

ex.r: ziu1 zou2 ge3 dei6 tit3 hou2 bik1
ex.en: The subway is packed in the morning.

ex.s: 間屋好細，住四個人好迫。
ex.r: gaan1 uk1 hou2 sai3 zyu6 sei3 go3 jan4 hou2 bik1
ex.en: The flat is small; it's cramped for four people.

ex.r: keoi5 aa3 maa1 bik1 keoi5 hok6 kam4
ex.en: Her mom makes her learn piano.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng5 mong5 caa4 haa5 gei2 dim2 hoi1 mun4
ex.en: I'll check online what time it opens.

ex.r: m4 sik1 go3 zi6 zau6 caa4 zi6 din2 laa1
ex.en: If you don't know the word, look it up in a dictionary.

ex.s: 機場職員要查我哋嘅行李。
ex.r: gei1 coeng4 zik1 jyun4 jiu3 caa4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 hang4 lei5
ex.en: Airport staff need to check our luggage.

ex.r: m4 goi1 bei2 zi1 seoi2 ngo5
ex.en: A bottle of water, please.

ex.r: nei5 jau5 mou5 zi1 bat1 ze3 ngo5 aa3
ex.en: Do you have a pen I can borrow?

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 jam2 do1 zi1 be1 zau2 laa1
ex.en: Let's have another bottle of beer.

ex.r: dai6 si4 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 au1 zau1 leoi5 hang4
ex.en: Someday I want to travel to Europe.

ex.r: nei5 dai6 si4 soeng2 zou6 me1 gung1 aa3
ex.en: What job do you want to do in the future?

ex.r: ji4 gaa1 cyu5 cin2 dai6 si4 maai5 lau2
ex.en: Save money now to buy a flat someday.

ex.s: 你睇咗今日嘅新聞未呀？
ex.r: nei5 tai2 zo2 gam1 jat6 ge3 san1 man2 mei6 aa3
ex.en: Have you seen today's news?

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 sau2 gei1 tai2 san1 man2
ex.en: I read the news on my phone.

ex.r: san1 man2 waa6 ting1 jat6 wui5 daa2 fung1
ex.en: The news says a typhoon is coming tomorrow.

note: For choice questions. In statements, 'or' is 或者.

ex.r: nei5 jam2 caa4 ding6 hai6 gaa3 fe1 aa3
ex.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

ex.s: 我哋搭地鐵定係搭的士呀？
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 daap3 dei6 tit3 ding6 hai6 daap3 dik1 si2 aa3
ex.en: Shall we take the subway or a taxi?

ex.r: nei5 jiu3 hung4 sik1 ding6 hai6 laam4 sik1
ex.en: Do you want red or blue?

ex.r: ngo5 zaam6 si4 zyu6 hai2 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2
ex.en: I'm staying at a friend's place for now.

ex.r: zaam6 si4 mou5 man6 tai4 do1 ze6
ex.en: No problems for now, thanks.

ex.s: 醫生話暫時唔好做運動。
ex.r: ji1 sang1 waa6 zaam6 si4 m4 hou2 zou6 wan6 dung6
ex.en: The doctor said not to exercise for now.

en: to shout; to call (out); to order (food)
note: 嗌交 (aai3 gaau1) = to argue.

ex.s: 唔好嗌咁大聲，細路瞓緊覺。
ex.r: m4 hou2 aai3 gam3 daai6 seng1 sai3 lou6 fan3 gan2 gaau3
ex.en: Don't shout so loudly; the kid is sleeping.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 aai3 ngo5 go3 meng2
ex.en: She called out my name on the street.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 aai3 ngoi6 maai6 laa1
ex.en: Let's order takeout.

note: Opposite: 壞處 (waai6 cyu3).

ex.s: 住喺呢度嘅好處係近地鐵站。
ex.r: zyu6 hai2 ni1 dou6 ge3 hou2 cyu3 hai6 kan5 dei6 tit3 zaam6
ex.en: The good thing about living here is it's near the subway.

ex.r: zou2 fan3 zou2 hei2 jau5 hou2 do1 hou2 cyu3
ex.en: Going to bed and getting up early has lots of benefits.

ex.s: 呢份工最大嘅好處係唔使加班。
ex.r: ni1 fan6 gung1 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 hou2 cyu3 hai6 m4 sai2 gaa1 baan1
ex.en: The best thing about this job is no overtime.

en: to endure; to put up with
note: 捱夜 = stay up late. 捱苦 = go through hardship.

ex.s: 佢後生嗰陣捱咗好多苦。
ex.r: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 ngaai4 zo2 hou2 do1 fu2
ex.en: He went through a lot of hardship when he was young.

ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 ngaai4 je6 zou6 je5
ex.en: I stayed up late working last night.

ex.s: 唔好成日捱夜，對身體唔好。
ex.r: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 ngaai4 je6 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2
ex.en: Don't stay up late all the time; it's bad for you.

ex.r: tai2 pin2 seng4 jat6 jau5 gwong2 gou3 hou2 faan4
ex.en: Videos always have ads; it's so annoying.

ex.s: 我喺報紙見到個招聘廣告。
ex.r: ngo5 hai2 bou3 zi2 gin3 dou2 go3 ziu1 ping3 gwong2 gou3
ex.en: I saw a job ad in the newspaper.

ex.r: dei6 tit3 zaam6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwong2 gou3
ex.en: There are lots of ads in the subway station.

ex.r: ngo5 faan1 gung1 wui5 ging1 gwo3 nei5 uk1 kei2
ex.en: I pass your place on my way to work.

ex.s: 經過超市幫我買支牛奶。
ex.r: ging1 gwo3 ciu1 si5 bong1 ngo5 maai5 zi1 ngau4 naai5
ex.en: When you pass the supermarket, grab me a bottle of milk.

ex.r: ni1 gaa3 baa1 si2 ging1 m4 ging1 gwo3 zung1 waan4 gaa3
ex.en: Does this bus go through Central?

ex.r: soeng5 tong4 m4 hou2 gong2 je5
ex.en: Don't talk in class.

ex.r: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 daai6 seng1
ex.en: He talks really loudly.

ex.s: 我同你講嘢，你有冇聽呀？
ex.r: ngo5 tung4 nei5 gong2 je5 nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 aa3

ex.en: I'm not used to Hong Kong's weather yet.

ex.r: ngo5 sik6 m4 gwaan3 gam3 laat6 ge3 je5
ex.en: I'm not used to eating food this spicy.

ex.s: 做咗一個月，而家慣晒喇。
ex.r: zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 jyut6 ji4 gaa1 gwaan3 saai3 laa3
ex.en: After a month on the job, I'm totally used to it.

ex.r: ngo5 ziu1 tau4 zou2 jiu3 jam2 gaa3 fe1
ex.en: I need coffee in the morning.

ex.r: ting1 jat6 ziu1 tau4 zou2 gau2 dim2 hai2 gung1 si1 gin3
ex.en: See you at the office at nine tomorrow morning.

ex.r: ziu1 tau4 zou2 heoi3 haang4 saan1 mou5 gam3 jit6
ex.en: Hiking in the morning isn't as hot.

ex.en: He crashed into a taxi while driving.

ex.r: siu2 sam1 aa3 m4 hou2 zong6 dou2 go3 tau4
ex.en: Careful, don't bump your head.

ex.r: ngo5 hai2 ciu1 si5 zong6 dou2 gau6 tung4 hok6
ex.en: I ran into an old classmate at the supermarket.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 zin2 tau4 faat3
ex.en: I want to get a haircut.

ex.r: ngo5 bong1 go3 zai2 zin2 zi2 gaap3
ex.en: I'm trimming my son's nails.

ex.r: jung6 gaau3 zin2 zin2 hoi1 go3 baau1 zong1
ex.en: Cut the packaging open with scissors.

ex.r: bei2 hei2 hoeng1 gong2 nau2 joek3 dung3 hou2 do1
ex.en: Compared with Hong Kong, New York is much colder.

ex.s: 比起出邊食，我寧願喺屋企煮。
ex.r: bei2 hei2 ceot1 bin6 sik6 ngo5 ning4 jyun2 hai2 uk1 kei2 zyu2
ex.en: Rather than eating out, I'd prefer to cook at home.

ex.r: bei2 hei2 gau6 nin2 gam1 nin2 saang1 ji3 hou2 zo2

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai6 zung1 hok6 tung4 hok6
ex.en: We were classmates in high school.

ex.r: go3 neoi2 gam1 nin2 sing1 zung1 hok6
ex.en: My daughter starts secondary school this year.

ex.r: keoi5 hai2 zung1 hok6 gaau3 jing1 man2
ex.en: She teaches English at a secondary school.

note: 慢慢嚟 = take your time.

ex.r: maan6 maan2 sik6 m4 sai2 gap1
ex.en: Eat slowly, there's no rush.

ex.r: nei5 maan6 maan2 gong2 ngo5 teng1 gan2
ex.en: Take your time telling me; I'm listening.

ex.r: lok6 jyu5 lou6 waat6 maan6 maan2 haang4
ex.en: It's rainy and slippery, so walk slowly.

en: can't be bothered; to save trouble

ex.r: ngo5 fai3 si6 zyu2 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 laa1
ex.en: I can't be bothered to cook; let's eat out.

ex.r: ngo5 fai3 si6 tung4 keoi5 aai3 gaau1
ex.en: I can't be bothered to argue with him.

ex.r: daai3 maai4 baa2 ze1 laa1 fai3 si6 lam4 sap1
ex.en: Take an umbrella so you don't get soaked.

en: for no reason; out of nowhere
note: Colloquial; same as 無緣無故.

ex.r: bou6 din6 nou5 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 sik1 zo2
ex.en: The computer shut off for no reason.

ex.r: keoi5 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 haam3 hei2 soeng5 lai4
ex.en: She started crying for no reason.

ex.r: ngo5 mou4 dyun1 dyun1 tou5 tung3
ex.en: I got a stomachache out of nowhere.

note: 減肥 = lose weight; 減價 = on sale.

ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 gaam2 fei4
ex.en: I need to lose weight.

ex.r: ni1 gin6 saam1 gaam2 gan2 gaa3
ex.en: This shirt is on sale.

ex.r: gung1 si1 gam1 nin2 gaam2 zo2 jan4 gung1
ex.en: The company cut salaries this year.

ex.r: dat6 jin4 gaan1 lok6 daai6 jyu5
ex.en: Suddenly it started pouring.

ex.s: 突然間停電，乜都睇唔到。
ex.r: dat6 jin4 gaan1 ting4 din6 mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 dou2
ex.en: Suddenly the power went out and I couldn't see a thing.

ex.r: keoi5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 waa6 m4 lai4
ex.en: He suddenly said he wasn't coming.

note: 做生意 = to do business, run a business.

ex.r: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 saang1 ji3 hou2 hou2
ex.en: This restaurant does great business.

ex.r: keoi5 zi6 gei2 zou6 saang1 ji3
ex.en: He runs his own business.

ex.s: 落雨天，啲舖頭冇乜生意。
ex.r: lok6 jyu5 tin1 di1 pou3 tau2 mou5 mat1 saang1 ji3
ex.en: On rainy days, the shops don't get much business.

note: Measure word 隻 for one eye, 對 for a pair.

ex.r: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 hou2 han4
ex.en: My eye is really itchy.

ex.r: saan1 maai4 ngaan5 fan3 gaau3 laa1
ex.en: Close your eyes and go to sleep.

ex.r: keoi5 deoi3 ngaan5 hou2 leng3
ex.en: She has beautiful eyes.

note: For 'like', Cantonese usually says 鍾意; 愛 is stronger.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 oi3 ngo5 uk1 kei2 jan4
ex.en: I really love my family.

ex.r: ngo5 oi3 nei5 ting1 jat6 gin3
ex.en: I love you. See you tomorrow.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 oi3 keoi5 zek3 maau1
ex.en: She really loves her cat.

en: to rely on; to depend on

ex.r: ni1 ci3 zan1 hai6 kaau3 saai3 nei5 laa3
ex.en: This time I'm counting on you completely.

ex.r: keoi5 duk6 syu1 kaau3 zoeng2 hok6 gam1
ex.en: She pays for her studies with a scholarship.

ex.s: 我哋喺外國全靠手機地圖。
ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 cyun4 kaau3 sau2 gei1 dei6 tou4
ex.en: Abroad, we rely completely on maps on our phones.

ex.r: ngo5 soeng2 san1 cing2 ni1 fan6 gung1
ex.en: I want to apply for this job.

ex.s: 去日本使唔使申請簽證呀？
ex.r: heoi3 jat6 bun2 sai2 m4 sai2 san1 cing2 cim1 zing3 aa3
ex.en: Do you need to apply for a visa to go to Japan?

ex.r: keoi5 san1 cing2 zo2 saam1 gaan1 daai6 hok6
ex.en: She applied to three universities.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 zip3 sau6 seon3 jung6 kaat1
ex.en: We accept credit cards.

ex.r: keoi5 zip3 sau6 zo2 fan6 san1 gung1
ex.en: He accepted the new job.

ex.r: ngo5 hou2 naan4 zip3 sau6 keoi5 zau2 zo2
ex.en: It's hard for me to accept that she's gone.

note: Usually followed by 都.

ex.r: ngo5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 gei3 dak1 ni1 jat1 jat6
ex.en: I'll always remember this day.

ex.s: 部電梯永遠都要等好耐。
ex.r: bou6 din6 tai1 wing5 jyun5 dou1 jiu3 dang2 hou2 noi6
ex.en: You always have to wait ages for the elevator.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 hou2 pang4 jau5
ex.en: We'll always be good friends.

note: Measure word 塊 (faai3): 塊面. 洗面 = wash your face.

ex.s: 佢塊面好紅，係咪發燒呀？
ex.r: keoi5 faai3 min6 hou2 hung4 hai6 mai6 faat3 siu1 aa3
ex.en: Her face is really red. Does she have a fever?

ex.r: sai2 jyun4 min6 sin1 sik6 zou2 caan1
ex.en: Wash your face before you have breakfast.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 min6 laa3
ex.en: We haven't seen each other in ages.

en: to send; to have (a fever, dream)
note: 發燒 = have a fever; 發夢 = dream.

ex.r: ngo5 faat3 zo2 go3 dyun2 seon3 bei2 nei5
ex.en: I sent you a text.

ex.r: go3 zai2 faat3 siu1 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 hok6
ex.en: My son has a fever, so he's not going to school today.

ex.s: 我尋晚發咗個好得意嘅夢。
ex.r: ngo5 cam4 maan5 faat3 zo2 go3 hou2 dak1 ji3 ge3 mung6
ex.en: I had a really funny dream last night.

note: Months are number + 月: 一月 to 十二月.

ex.r: ngo5 baat3 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2
ex.en: I'm going to Japan in August.

ex.r: baat3 jyut6 hou2 jit6 seng4 jat6 daa2 fung1
ex.en: August is hot, and there are lots of typhoons.

ex.r: ngo5 go3 zai2 baat3 jyut6 saang1 jat6
ex.en: My son's birthday is in August.

en: to be unemployed; to lose one's job

ex.r: keoi5 sat1 jip6 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6
ex.en: He's been out of work for three months.

ex.s: 爸爸失業之後，我哋要慳啲使。
ex.r: baa4 baa1 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 haan1 di1 sai2
ex.en: After Dad lost his job, we had to spend less.

ex.r: sat1 jip6 kei4 gaan1 keoi5 hok6 sik1 zyu2 faan6
ex.en: While he was out of work, he learned to cook.

note: 月尾 = end of the month; 尾班車 = last train or bus.

ex.r: ngo5 dei6 gon2 m4 cit3 mei5 baan1 ce1
ex.en: We didn't make the last train.

ex.r: jyut6 mei5 sin1 ceot1 loeng4
ex.en: We don't get paid until the end of the month.

ex.r: tou3 hei3 go3 mei5 hou2 gam2 jan4
ex.en: The ending of the movie is really moving.
